text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 1.7–1.8% over the past day, signaling modest selling pressure across the two largest assets without panic. Fear & Greed sits at 27 (Fear) with no recent shift, indicating sustained caution rather than capitulation or euphoria. Bitcoin's dominance near 56% and moderate 24-hour volume of $54B suggest investors are rotating cautiously rather than fleeing crypto entirely.
